title: Daily mission ledger summary on desktop-account replies
description: Additive (HolobotsMobile host-economy-hardening-2) top-level `dailyMissionLedger` on every desktop-account-1/2/3 reply of desktopAccountSnapshot; no wire version change. A read-only summary of the server-only users/{uid}.dailyMissionLedger for the host's current UTC day (`day`). Counts come from the ledger only and are 0 when it was last reset on another day. `claimed[missionId]` is true exactly when claimDailyMission would refuse already_claimed today. Clients render daily-mission progress from this object, not from the client-writable rewardSystem copy. Mission targets and rewards are the DAILY_MISSION_TABLE (daily_login 1, arena_v2_battle 3 arenaBattlesToday, open_booster_pack 1 boosterPacksToday); daily_login progress is always 1 for a signed-in pilot.
